confidence_notes: Holistic estimates without live city-price sourcing. Food anchors are more predictable than lodging; Kyoto's November foliage demand makes room rates especially uncertain. Cocktail and wine prices are estimated from their usual local relationship to draft beer.
comparable_city_reasoning: Broadly comparable to major Japanese visitor cities such as Osaka and Tokyo for food and drink, with Kyoto's autumn-foliage demand lifting accommodation prices.
